topic: Requesting unique traffic data for Spain
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on retrieving historical and unique user traffic data. Initially, a request was made to recalculate permanent metrics for the master facility in Hong Kong. Later, [p1] requested unique traffic data (unique users) for a mall cluster in Spain for specific date ranges: January 2022 and May 2022. The required granularity was confirmed to be daily. A complex SQL query template was provided by someone to assist with the data extraction.
decisions: The unique traffic data request for Spain (Jan/May 2022) is being processed.
A detailed SQL query structure was shared to facilitate the data pull.
action_items: Someone needs to run the provided SQL query using specific parameters (company_num = 7862, facility details, and date ranges).
The unique traffic data for Spain will be delivered via a request/export mechanism.
